title: Lab DevTools request investigation
description: Investigate a local synthetic request with DevTools, classify response failures, preserve redacted evidence and avoid depending on live third-party servers.
objectives: Inspect a local fetch entry and response metadata in DevTools
Distinguish a successful response, simulated HTTP error and JSON parse failure
Write a repeatable reproduction and redacted observation
Complete a deterministic offline request triage capstone
rubric: I inspected the locally generated fetch response in DevTools.
I distinguished real local fetch evidence from simulated HTTP error responses.
I documented one reproducible failure with sensitive values redacted.
